instructions: Vantage is a multi-tenant SaaS: Neon Postgres per workspace, Next.js App Router, Cloudflare Workers. Prioritise correctness and tenant isolation over style. Every database read or write must be scoped to a workspace id. Flag anything that could leak one workspace's data to another, any unauthenticated mutation, and any user-supplied URL fetched without the policy in lib/collectors/safeFetch.ts. Error messages returned to customers must stay generic; internal detail belongs in logs.

rules.rule: Every query and mutation must be scoped by workspace id. A missing workspace predicate is a P0.
Server actions and API routes must call authorizeWorkspace and refuse on failure before any database write.
User-supplied URLs must go through guardedFetch from lib/collectors/safeFetch.ts. Raw fetch() on user input is a security issue.
Never introduce credentials, tokens or live customer data into source, tests, fixtures or logs.
Fixture sample data must never be persisted or shown as real leads in production unless ALLOW_FIXTURES is explicitly set.
Schema changes must be additive (expand/contract). Dropping a column or table in the same release as the code that stops using it is a bug.
